intro: This is the knowledge element of Care Certificate Standard 2, covering how you reflect, use supervision and appraisal, and plan your ongoing development.
points: Never wait for a scheduled supervision meeting to report an urgent safeguarding concern; raise those straight away, following your safeguarding policy.
This e-learning covers knowledge only; your competence must also be observed at work and signed off by your employer.
Work within your job description and agreed ways of working; if a task falls outside your training, ask rather than guess.
Reflect using a simple describe, evaluate and plan model so everyday experiences and mistakes become lasting improvements in your care.
Make the most of supervision and appraisal by preparing, speaking openly, receiving feedback with an open mind and acting on agreed objectives.
Keep your personal development plan and portfolio alive, and always anonymise or remove personal details of the people you support.
